export.title: Export Sticker
export.subtitle: Official WhatsApp format & multiple platforms
export.howItWorksTitle: How to send as an official sticker (not photo):
export.howItWorksDesc: WhatsApp treats Ctrl+V and standard share as normal photos. On PC, click '+' in WhatsApp and select 'New Sticker' (or drag the image). On mobile, use Sticker Maker (.wastickers)!
export.createInWhatsAppDesc: Downloads the official sticker and opens WhatsApp to create it
export.stepGuideTitle: How to finish in WhatsApp (3 quick steps):
export.step1Desc: In the WhatsApp chat, click the '+' (Attach) icon next to the message input.
export.step2Desc: Select 'New Sticker' (or drag the downloaded file into the conversation).
export.step3Desc: Pick the sticker from your Downloads folder. Sends with transparent background!
export.officialNotice: Notice: WhatsApp treats Ctrl+V or standard system shares as regular photos. Using the '+' button is the only way in WhatsApp Web to send as an official sticker!
export.openWhatsAppDesc: Copies image and opens WhatsApp to paste
export.shareWhatsAppDesc: Share the file with your contacts or other apps
export.copyImageDesc: Copy and paste (Ctrl+V) into WhatsApp Web or Telegram
export.downloadWastickersDesc: Opens in Sticker Maker to add to official tray with 1 tap
export.downloadWebpDesc: On WhatsApp Web: click '+' and choose 'New Sticker', or drag into chat
export.downloadPngDesc: High resolution for design, social media or other apps
export.guideWeb: On WhatsApp Web: Download the WebP, click '+' and choose 'New Sticker'.
export.guideMobile: On Mobile: Use the .wastickers button and open with Sticker Maker to add to drawer.
export.guideApps: On Android/iOS: You can also import via Sticker Maker or Sticker.ly.
export.guideWebDesc: Download the WebP (or drag the sticker directly into chat). In WhatsApp Web, click '+' (Attach) and choose 'New Sticker' to send with transparent background!
export.guideMobileDesc: Save the sticker to Photos. In WhatsApp, open the sticker keyboard, tap '+' (Create), and select the saved photo. WhatsApp creates the official sticker instantly!
export.guideAppsDesc: Tap 'Add to WhatsApp (.wastickers)'. When opening the file in Sticker Maker, tap 'Add to WhatsApp' to install the sticker permanently in your drawer!
export.savedSuccess: Sticker saved to your local pack!
export.copiedError: Could not copy directly. Use the Download button.
